I bought my Horizon Fitness products from their parent company Johnson Fitness.

The Horizon Paragon X Treadmill is an unreliable and poorly manufactured treadmill. The Horizon 7.0IC bike is a poorly made indoor spin bike made of low quality parts.

In general, Horizon gym and cardio equipment is low quality and should be avoided. The customer service provided by Horizon through their parent company Johnson Health Tech Australia is extremely low quality.

Johnson Health Tech Australia, or as it says on their website Johnson Fitness, is unwilling to honour their advertised product standards and inclusions.

The Horizon Paragon X Treadmill has:

1\. This machine has multiple defects (listed below);

2\. Low quality controls and poor user experience design. It is difficult to do intervals etc with the controls set as they are;

3\. The Air system doesn't integrate with anything and is completely unlabelled with no guidance notes so you can't tell what you're supposed to be running on.

Don't get caught up in this marketing gimmick. Buy a different treadmill.

The Paragon X commonly ships with multiple defects, proven by multiple reviews:
